content.title: Why Your Hair Won't Grow
content.caption: Three habits that quietly wreck length retention.
content.overall_description: A creator films a quick bathroom mirror video explaining why hair seems stuck at the same length. The pacing is fast, blunt, and practical, with simple examples that make the advice easy to follow.

key_frames.description: Opening mirror shot with the creator holding up split ends and saying the problem is usually breakage, not slow growth.
Cut to close-up of rough towel drying and tight brushing, with on-screen text showing those as the first two habits to stop.
Final frame shows a satin pillowcase and a wide-tooth comb, with the creator pointing to a simple wash day routine and saying consistency beats miracle products.

content.audio_transcript: If your hair is not getting longer, it is probably breaking off faster than it grows. Stop scrubbing it like a gym towel, stop yanking through knots, and stop buying random miracle oil because the bottle has good vibes. Use a conditioner that actually slips, dry it gently, and comb from the ends up. That is the boring answer. The boring answer usually works.
